title: Twin Fates
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ling's voice, terrifyingly calm, rang out once more: "Do you think over these three years, who has been bearing the Heavenly Dao's gaze for you?"

text.content: The dusk outside the imperial capital's city gate was stained with a faint layer of blood-red. Chen Ji stood on the city tower, his gaze piercing through the layers of tiled eaves, falling upon that familiar figure. Chen Nian, her clothes already tattered and worn, yet the wooden box clutched tightly in her arms gleamed softly under the setting sun. Three years,整整 three years, every night he divined the Heavenly Secrets, he would see this name flickering in the mists of fate, yet each time it became blurred because of her. "Nian Nian..." his voice was very soft, soft as if squeezed from between his teeth, and on that eternally calm face, cracks finally began to appear.

Just as he was about to step down the stairs, a chill suddenly exploded from the depths of his mind. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—the remnant soul that had been quietly lying on the first page of the Tianji Record—the prohibition left by Mo Xiansheng—was now trembling violently. At the same time, a voice he had never heard before sounded within his consciousness, clear, cold, and familiar, yet carrying an unsettling sense of alienation: "Three years, brother." The voice paused, seemingly examining him, "You've changed a lot, and... become much weaker."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stopped abruptly, his face turning deathly pale in an instant. The voice's tone was identical to Chen Nian's, yet it carried a coldness and scrutiny he had never sensed in her. He took a deep breath, silently reciting the incantation of the Tianji Record, attempting to capture the source of this strange sensation. But in the next instant, his body froze—he discovered he couldn't mobilize even a thread of Heavenly Fate, as if some invisible force had completely severed his connection to the Tianji Record.

"The relic you seek," the voice rang out again, this time with a hint of playful amusement, "did you think it was meant to save her?" Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly in his sleeves, his knuckles whitening from the strain. He sensed it—the source of that power wasn't external, but came from the deepest part of himself—from that page of the Tianji Record Fragment he had never been able to fully decipher. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul quivered violently within the prohibition, seemingly trying to warn him of something, yet perpetually unable to break through that intangible barrier.

text.content: "Who are you?" Chen Ji's voice remained eerily calm, as if an abyss of turmoil churned beneath his composed exterior. Yet deep within his Mental Sea, chaos erupted—the ink on the first page of the Tianji Record was visibly fading, replaced by ancient characters he had never encountered: "Heavenly Secrets as the pen, fate in the left hand, cause and effect in the right, twin-born, returning to chaos." Chen Ji's pupils dilated as a terrifying speculation took shape in his mind.

choice.prompt: Faced with this sudden transformation deep within his consciousness, Chen Ji must make a choice—how should he confront this mysterious existence that claims to share his origin?

choices.description: Suppress the turbulent waves in his heart and interact with this being in the most composed manner possible, attempting to extract more information. Always remember—never reveal your trump cards to an adversary.
choices.risk_hint: The Other Party Might Seize the Opportunity to Attack His Mental Sea

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, drawing all his consciousness into a tight sphere, awaiting the next move of his opponent. The voice seemed to sense his intention and let out an ambiguous laugh: "Interesting, as prudent as I anticipated. Indeed... my other half."

choices.description: Proactively sever a portion of his connection to the Tianji Record in exchange for the other's trust and more information. This was a reckless gamble, yet sometimes only by demonstrating sufficient sincerity could one break through an impasse.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Some Heavenly Fate Value and Prohibition Protection
choices.visible_reward: Might Gain the Other's Genuine Acknowledgment
choices.risk_hint: After Severance, He Might Forever Lose Part of His Power

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly mobilized the remaining Heavenly Fate Value within his body, actively severing a portion of his connection to the Tianji Record. Excruciating pain surged from the depths of his Mental Sea, and blood trickled from his seven orifices. However, in the next moment, the voice fell silent. When it spoke again, there was a subtle, almost imperceptible tremor in its tone: "You actually... would sacrifice so much for me?"

choices.description: No longer concealing anything, directly counterattack the other's encroachment on his Mental Sea with the power of the Tianji Record Fragment. This was the trump card he had meticulously cultivated over many years—he would never reveal it casually until the final moment—yet now, he had no path left.
choices.visible_cost: Revealing Part of His Trump Card Might Provoke the Other Party to Launch a Full-Scale Attack
choices.visible_reward: Might Reclaim the Initiative in the Mental Sea
choices.risk_hint: The Other's Strength Runs Deep and Unfathomable, Potentially Resulting in Mutual Destruction

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes suddenly turned ice-cold and piercing. He urgently activated the power of the Tianji Record. The characters on the fragment leapt like living things, transforming into golden chains that wrapped around that strange consciousness. However, in the next instant, his expression completely changed—the golden chains not only failed to bind the opponent, but were swallowed whole by that consciousness, becoming nourishment for its growth.

dialogue.content: "I've told you, you've grown weaker." That voice rang out again, this time carrying an indescribable emotion. "In these three years, you've spent too much Heavenly Fate on those boring schemes, while I absorbed your nutrients during my slumber... We were one being to begin with. Every calculation of yours only made me stronger." Chen Ji's fist slowly clenched. He sensed the true nature of that power—it was not external invasion, but another "self" gestated from within his own destiny.

text.content: The Tianji Record's fragment transformed completely at this moment. The originally incomplete text was completing itself at an unbelievable speed, and the newly revealed content made Chen Ji's heart sink completely: "Destiny is twin-born, one holds the brush, one holds the book. The one who holds the brush writes destiny, the one who holds the book bears karma. When the two meet, three paths may be chosen—merge, destroy each other, or compete." A bitter smile curved Chen Ji's lips. So this was the true reason for the Tianji Record's incompleteness—it had been waiting all along for the awakening of its other half.

dialogue.content: "My name is Chen Ling." That voice suddenly spoke, carrying a strange anticipation in its tone. "Not Chen Nian—me. I am the half sleeping within your body, the source of Heavenly Fate you consume every time you activate the Tianji Record. You created the Tianji Record, but I am its true foundation. Without me, you are nothing." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. At this moment, he finally understood why every use of the Foresight Ability consumed Heavenly Fate—it was not consumption, but awakening.

text.content: Below the city tower, Chen Nian seemed to sense something. She abruptly raised her head, her gaze passing through the layered roof tiles to meet Chen Ji's. Her eyes held confusion, and more so, fear—as if she too had sensed the existence awakening within her at this moment. "Brother..." Her voice came through the evening wind of dusk, carrying a whimper. "I had a very long dream, and someone kept calling my name in the dream..." Chen Ji's heart clenched tightly. In his gaze toward Chen Nian, there appeared an emotion more complex than any he had ever felt before.

choice.prompt: Chen Ling demanded a debate with Chen Ji over "who is the true writer," which concerned the direction of both their fates. Which method do you choose for this debate?

choices.description: Use all the schemes and calculations you've accumulated over three years to prove your value. Logic and facts will determine who truly deserves to dominate this body.
choices.visible_reward: May persuade with reason and win the debate
choices.risk_hint: The opponent may not agree with your logic

text.content: Chen Ji's voice echoed through the Mental Sea, each word as firm as metal and stone: "I have proven the value of the writer through three years of schemes. The three major sects, the Demonic Path invasion, the Heavenly Dao's attention—which of these was not a chess game I personally arranged?" Chen Ling's voice suddenly paused, as if in thought. However, in the next instant, she let out a light laugh: "Those chess games... which move was not built upon my slumber? Do you think the Heavenly Dao allowed you to reach today for no reason?"

choices.description: Awaken Chen Ling's memories of Chen Nian. Use the bonds of blood and kinship to prove you were always one entity—strife is meaningless.

text.content: Chen Ji's voice suddenly softened: "Chen Ling, have you forgotten Chen Nian? She is our sister, our only kin in this world." A violent fluctuation suddenly rippled through the Mental Sea, and that voice fell silent for a long time. When it spoke again, there was a barely perceptible tremor in its tone: "Chen Nian... of course I remember. In fact, it was precisely because of her that I was able to completely awaken."

choices.description: No more words—directly use all strength to force Chen Ling back into the depths of the Mental Sea. Even if she is the other half of the Tianji Record, she shall not seize dominance from his hands.

text.content: Chen Ji said no more. He urgently activated all the power of the Tianji Record, golden light exploding around him and transforming into chains that shot toward the depths of the Mental Sea. However, in the next instant, an even more violent force erupted from within the Mental Sea in retaliation. Chen Ji's body stiffened abruptly, and blood spilled from his lips. "I've told you," Chen Ling's voice carried a cold edge at this moment, "without me, you are nothing."

dialogue.content: "Do you know why the Heavenly Dao chose us?" Chen Ling's voice suddenly became low and eerie. "Because we were born as its chess pieces. The Tianji Record is not your fortuitous opportunity but your shackles. I am not your other half but another lock upon these shackles." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He perceived the terrifying truth within Chen Ling's words. The Eye of the Heavenly Dao had never disappeared. It had been waiting, waiting for both of them to awaken simultaneously, and then... to capture them all in one net.

text.content: Chen Nian's figure had arrived beneath the city tower. She raised her head, tears streaming down her face as she looked at Chen Ji, her lips trembling slightly but unable to speak. Chen Ji sensed it—the two consciousnesses flickering alternately in those eyes. One was his sister Chen Nian, the other was Chen Ling who had just awakened. "Three years ago, people from the Holy Sect captured me," Chen Nian's voice spoke, yet carrying Chen Ling's tone. "They used my blood to open a certain door, and behind that door lies the origin of Heavenly Dao."

dialogue.content: "Let us become one." Chen Ling's voice suddenly turned unprecedentedly serious. "Only when our two consciousnesses merge completely can we open the passage to the origin of Heavenly Dao. Only then can we truly break free from this chess game that has been played for ten million years." Chen Ji's fist slowly clenched. He sensed the sincerity in Chen Ling's words—but also the ambition hidden behind that sincerity. She wanted to主导这场融合，就像他一直主导着这具身体一样。"You have your schemes, I have my ambition," Chen Ling's voice rang out again, as if seeing through his hesitation. "But we have a common enemy—the Eye of Heavenly Dao."

choice.prompt: Chen Ling proposed the merger, a fusion that would determine who the true master would be. How do you choose to respond to this fateful decision?

choices.description: Accept Chen Ling's proposal, allowing the two consciousnesses to merge on equal terms. This is a grand gamble, but perhaps the only way to break the deadlock.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the complete power of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The possibility of losing oneself during the merger

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes. When his consciousness opened again, he found himself in a vast sea of stars. Chen Ling's figure was not far away, woven from countless points of light, facing him across the distance. "You've finally agreed." Her voice carried a hint of imperceptible relief. "Then let us begin—this merger's result will determine who can wield the brush to write a new destiny."

choices.description: Refuse the merger, using the power of the Tianji Record Fragment to seal Chen Ling again. No matter how eloquently she spoke, he would not hand his destiny over to others.
choices.visible_cost: May forever lose the opportunity for the complete Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ling may completely turn hostile

text.content: A cold determination flickered in Chen Ji's eyes: "I refuse." His voice carried not the slightest hesitation, as firm as steel. Chen Ling's voice suddenly turned sharp: "You're insane! This is our only chance!" However, Chen Ji had already begun activating the prohibition. Golden chains emerged once more in his Mental Sea—this time not for attack, but for sealing. "I would rather be a chess piece for eternity," his voice cold as ice, "than hand my destiny over to an existence without physical form."

choices.description: Neither refuse nor accept, but propose your own conditions—the merger can happen, but dominance must be in my hands. This is a psychological chess match, to see who yields more.
choices.visible_cost: Negotiations may fall into a stalemate
choices.risk_hint: The other party may not accept the conditions

text.content: A meaningful smile curved Chen Ji's lips: "The merger can happen, but I have one condition." Chen Ling's voice carried a hint of caution: "Speak." Chen Ji's voice turned cold and slow: "Dominance belongs to me, and the first action after the merger will be decided by me." Chen Ling fell silent for a moment, then let out an ambiguous laugh: "You truly haven't changed at all. Very well, I agree—but if you fail, I will take over everything."

Chen Ji's consciousness confronted Chen Ling within his Mental Sea. The collision of two powers sent monstrous waves surging through his Mental Sea. Yet at this moment, an even more terrifying perception surged forth—within the Tianji Record, a line of ancient characters slowly emerged, each word striking his soul like thunder: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao has been watching for long. When the twins awaken, it will be the day of the harvest." Chen Ji's face turned deathly pale in an instant. So this was the true purpose of the Eye of Heavenly Dao—to make them destroy each other, then eliminate them all in one sweep when they were at their weakest.

dialogue.content: Chen Ling's voice suddenly sounded, carrying an unprecedented gravity: "You saw it?" Chen Ji did not answer, but his silence was the best answer. Chen Ling's voice sounded again, this time with a hint of bitterness: "It seems we both underestimated that existence. From the very beginning, it knew of our existence, and it may have even... created me." Chen Ji's fist slowly clenched. An even more terrifying speculation took shape in his mind—if Chen Ling was created by Heavenly Dao, then what about the Tianji Record? What about himself? Was all of this within Heavenly Dao's calculations?

text.content: At this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly erupted with blinding golden light. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fluctuated violently within the prohibition, seemingly trying to convey something important. Chen Ji urgently activated the Tianji Record, attempting to capture what Mo Xiansheng wanted to say. However, in the next instant, his expression completely changed—Mo Xiansheng had left not a warning, but a segment of long-sealed memory. "Chen Ji," Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in the memory, "when you see these words, it means the Tianji Record has awakened half its power. But what I must tell you is—Chen Ling is not your enemy. She is the other half of the Tianji Record's will, and your only hope of escaping Heavenly Dao's chess game."

dialogue.content: Chen Ling's voice sounded again, this time carrying a complex emotion: "It seems your master understands us better than I do. He's right—I am the other half of the Tianji Record's will. But what he didn't say is that once we merge, we can never be separated again. At that time, whether I or you will hold dominance... even I don't know." Chen Ji sensed the sincerity in her words, and also the profound unease hidden behind that sincerity. Two existences born from the same origin, yet forced to stand in opposition from the very beginning of their fate—this itself was Heavenly Dao's cruelest joke.

text.content: Chen Nian stood quietly beneath the city tower, her eyes reflecting the last rays of the lingering sunset on the horizon. Her tears had dried on her cheeks, leaving faint traces behind. Chen Ji gazed at her, and an indescribable desolation suddenly surged in his heart. No matter which of him and Chen Ling would ultimately claim dominance, the one who would be hurt deepest would always be this innocent girl before him. She had sacrificed three years of freedom merely to become the key to awakening Chen Ling; and even if she learned all the truths behind this, she would never harbor resentment toward anyone. This was the destiny of the Chen Family bloodline—tossed about by fate, yet forever preserving the purest kindness.

'I will not fuse.' Chen Ji's voice reverberated through the Mental Sea, calm and resolute. Chen Ling's voice suddenly turned sharp: 'You—' Yet Chen Ji cut her off: 'I will not fuse, nor will I seal you away. You are right—Heavenly Dao is our common enemy. Instead of making a choice now, why don't we... coexist temporarily?' Chen Ling fell silent. This proposal clearly caught her off guard. After a long while, her voice emerged once more, carrying a trace of imperceptible tremor: 'Coexist? Do you understand what that means? Our consciousnesses will be eternally intertwined, and neither of us will ever have solitude.'

A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips—that smile carrying his unique blend of calculation and composure: 'I know. But this also means we can share everything with each other—your knowledge, my experience; your strength, my strategies.' Chen Ling fell silent once more, and this silence stretched for an extremely long time. When she spoke again, there was a hint of imperceptible acknowledgment in her tone: 'You are more unhinged than I imagined.' Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, his gaze piercing through the twilight dusk to fall upon Chen Nian: 'Unhinged? I simply dislike handing my destiny over to others.'

Just then, a dull, resonant boom echoed from the capital's city gate. Chen Ji's expression shifted abruptly. His perception detected the disturbance within the city—countless powerful auras were converging toward this location, and several of them even made him sense danger. 'The Tianqing Sect has arrived,' Chen Ling's voice resonated in the Mental Sea, carrying a weight of gravity, 'and there's also the aura of the Xuanwu Sect. Han Lie is among them.' Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly. The timing was too coincidental—could the布局 of the Heavenly Dao's Eye already be in motion? He looked down at Chen Nian beneath the tower, and an unprecedented sense of urgency swelled in his heart—no matter how perilous the path ahead, he must protect this sister of his.
